reviewNotes: Amfani (2018) lists Kamuku among Kebbi's languages and Wikipedia lists it for Sokoto, without LGAs.
name: Kamuku

summary.text: The Kamuku live in the hills of west-central Niger State, mostly in Mariga and Rafi LGAs, with smaller numbers towards Birnin Gwari in Kaduna. Their speech is a cluster of Kainji languages, each lect tied to a particular hill. More than 35,000 people in 1996.
